candidate: VOLUME_RQA_RTE_OVER_VAVG_RATIO_SHOCK_MR (RQA ratio RTE/VAVG on delay-embedded log-volume returns; RTE=Shannon entropy (nats) of white vertical line length (recurrence-time gap) distribution over qualifying gaps w>=w_min excluding trivial self; VAVG=mean vertical/laminar black line length over qualifying vertical runs v>=l_min with LOI/self excluded for laminar counting; RATIO_RTE_VAVG=RTE/VAVG; m=2,tau=1,eps=0.5*std(r_window),W_RR=168,w_min=1,l_min=2)
feature_definition: RATIO_RTE_VAVG = RTE / VAVG. RTE = Shannon entropy (nats) of white vertical line length (recurrence-time gap) distribution: per column j, gap lengths w of consecutive zeros between recurrent points excluding i==j; qualifying w>=w_min (w_min=1), p_w=n_w/sum_u n_u, RTE=-sum_w p_w*ln(p_w); fail-closed if <2 distinct qualifying gap lengths or entropy non-finite/non-positive. VAVG = mean vertical/laminar black line length: qualifying vertical runs of consecutive 1-cells in each column j with run length v>=l_min (l_min=2); the trivial self point (i==j) is treated as a break (R[j,j] excluded from black-run counting) to avoid LOI contamination. VAVG = mean of those qualifying lengths. Fail-closed if no qualifying vertical lines or VAVG <= 0/non-finite. On trailing delay embedding (m=2,tau=1), L-inf recurrence eps=0.5*std(window). Causal trailing only; fail-closed to NaN/no-signal if RTE/VAVG/ratio undefined/non-finite/degenerate or insufficient qualifying lines/gaps.

params.vavg_definition: VAVG = mean vertical/laminar black line length. params.gap_definition: gap length w = number of consecutive 0-cells between successive recurrent points in a column (excluding trivial self at i==j)
